title: Euodia rutaecarpa (Juss.) Benth. var. officinalis (Dode) Huang and evodiamine ameliorate N-methyl-N'-nitro-N-nitrosoguanidine-induced chronic atrophic gastritis in rats via the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B/nuclear factor kappa-B pathway.
authors: Wang, Liping; Gao, Feng; Tian, Jingzhuo; Wang, Lianmei; Zhao, Yong; Liu, Suyan; Yi, Yan; Li, Chunying; Liu, Chenyue; Meng, Jing; Zhang, Yushi; Pan, Chen; Han, Jiayin; Liu, Meiting; Wang, Xingwen; Cui, Shuang; Jia, Liqun; Liang, Aihua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吴茱萸水提物及活性成分吴茱萸碱通过PI3K/AKT/NF-κB通路改善慢性萎缩性胃炎，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG) is a common chronic digestive disorder associated with the occurrence and development of gastric cancer (GC). Euodia rutaecarpa (Juss.) Benth. var. officinalis (Dode) Huang (Fructus evodiae) is a traditional Chinese medicinal material often used to treat gastrointestinal diseases. However, the therapeutical effects of Fructus evodiae in CAG and underlying mechanisms remain unelucidated. PURPOSE: This study aimed to determine the efficacy of the water decoction of fructus evodiae in the treatment of CAG, reveal its mechanism of action, clarify its pharmacological material basis and regulatory pathways in the treatment of CAG, and provide a scientific basis for the clinical treatment of CAG with fructus evodiae. METHOD: First, we established CAG rat model and administered fructus evodiae decoction for treatment, monitoring serum inflammatory factors, hormones, and histopathology. Then, components of fructus evodiae decoction were determined using UHPLC-Q Exactive Orbitrap HRMS. Subsequently, the mechanism of fructus evodiae in the treatment of CAG were explored by proteomics analysis, network pharmacology and molecular docking. Finally, in vivo and in vitro validation was taken by western blot (WB) assays, ELISA, CCK-8, immunofluorescence staining, hematoxylin and eosin (HE) measurement, bile acid (BAs) analysed. RESULTS: Data showed that 25 compounds were identified in fructus evodiae decoction. The proteomics analysis, network pharmacology, and molecular docking results showed evodiamine (EVO) is a major active ingredient and PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway and gastrointestinal motility are key regulating pathways in fructus evodiae decoction used to treat CAG. In vivo and in vitro experiments confirmed that Fructus evodiae decoction and EVO significantly reduced the expression levels of IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha, Gastrin-17 (G-17), somatostatin (SS), caudal type homeobox 2 (CDX2), and mucin 2 (MUC2) protein by inhibited PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling. Moreover, fructus evodiae decoction and EVO increased the expression of the gastrointestinal excitatory neurotransmitters ACh and 5-HT, promoted gastric emptying rate and small intestinal propulsion rate, and reduced the level of BAs in the stomach, thereby reducing further damage to the gastric mucosa. CONCLUSION: Fructus evodiae decoction exerts anti-CAG effects primarily by suppressing chronic inflammation and intestinal metaplasia through inhibition of the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby reducing bile acid accumulation and restoring gastrointestinal function. Importantly, evodiamine was identified as a key bioactive alkaloid of Fructus evodiae and was further validated as a critical mediator of these effects via targeted in vivo and in vitro experiments. By integrating proteomics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and single-compound mechanistic validation, this study establishes evodiamine-centered regulation of the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB axis as a unifying mechanism underlying the therapeutic action of Fructus evodiae in MNNG-induced chronic atrophic gastritis.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性萎缩性胃炎（CAG）是一种常见的慢性消化系统疾病，与胃癌（GC）的发生和发展相关。吴茱萸（Euodia rutaecarpa (Juss.) Benth. var. officinalis (Dode) Huang）（Fructus evodiae）是一种常用于治疗胃肠道疾病的传统中药材。然而，吴茱萸在CAG中的治疗效果及其潜在机制尚未阐明。目的：本研究旨在确定吴茱萸水煎剂治疗CAG的疗效，揭示其作用机制，阐明其在CAG治疗中的药理物质基础和调控通路，并为吴茱萸临床治疗CAG提供科学依据。方法：首先，建立CAG大鼠模型并给予吴茱萸煎剂治疗，监测血清炎症因子、激素和组织病理学。然后，使用UHPLC-Q Exactive Orbitrap HRMS测定吴茱萸煎剂的成分。随后，通过蛋白质组学分析、网络药理学和分子对接探讨吴茱萸治疗CAG的机制。最后，通过蛋白质印迹（WB）实验、ELISA、CCK-8、免疫荧光染色、苏木精和伊红（HE）测量以及胆汁酸（BAs）分析进行体内和体外验证。结果：数据显示，在吴茱萸煎剂中鉴定出25种化合物。蛋白质组学分析、网络药理学和分子对接结果表明，吴茱萸碱（EVO）是主要活性成分，PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路和胃肠运动是吴茱萸煎剂治疗CAG的关键调控通路。体内和体外实验证实，吴茱萸煎剂和EVO通过抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号，显著降低IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha、胃泌素-17（G-17）、生长抑素（SS）、尾型同源盒2（CDX2）和黏蛋白2（MUC2）蛋白的表达水平。此外，吴茱萸煎剂和EVO增加了胃肠兴奋性神经递质ACh和5-HT的表达，促进胃排空率和小肠推进率，并降低胃内BAs水平，从而减少对胃黏膜的进一步损伤。结论：吴茱萸煎剂主要通过抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路来抑制慢性炎症和肠上皮化生，从而发挥抗CAG作用，进而减少胆汁酸积累并恢复胃肠功能。重要的是，吴茱萸碱被鉴定为吴茱萸的关键生物活性生物碱，并通过靶向体内和体外实验进一步验证为这些效应的关键介导因子。通过整合蛋白质组学、网络药理学、分子对接和单化合物机制验证，本研究确立了以吴茱萸碱为中心的PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB轴调控作为吴茱萸在MNNG诱导的慢性萎缩性胃炎中治疗作用的统一机制。
